title: Map the smart cuts before totalizing
statement: For abelian B and Grothendieck abelian C and a left exact additive G:B→C, a bicomplex I with horizontal degrees in Z and vertical degrees in N has a natural isomorphism from its smart-cut tower followed by mappedFunctor G and totalization to the total smart-cut tower of mappedFunctor G applied to I. This commutes with every bicomplex map.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Tags 0118, 0156, 015K and 015X; the indicated proof steps of the CE comparison.

proof.text: Extension from N to Z preserves finite limits: after evaluation in a nonnegative degree it is the corresponding evaluation functor, and in a negative degree it is zero. Apply the extended smart truncation comparison to the vertical functor G followed by extension, then whisker by totalization. Its naturality follows by totalizing the already proved naturality square.

lean.statement:
theorem mappedSmartTruncationTowerIso_naturality
    {I J : HomologicalComplex₂ B (.up ℤ) (.up ℕ)} (f : I ⟶ J) :
    mappedSmartTruncationTowerMap G f ≫ (mappedSmartTruncationTowerIso G J).hom =
      (mappedSmartTruncationTowerIso G I).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex₂.smartTruncationTowerMap ((mappedFunctor G).map f)
